title: The terminal and the bestiary, the enemies' piece: B or the console under the Stålheart's gantry opens a terminal over the paused game (a frame, a list, a card, a live stage through a colour CRT pass) with an entry per Pearl tier and per kit creature, packs hunting a lure at the high hull; the lab's BESTIARY button opens the same terminal
context: Owner, 2026-10-14: 're-vamp the Units section; Vivarium, Bestiary, Compendium, we will find it a better name and 1) display all the unlocked units in their full glory, enemies at high resolution with smooth animations displaying their movement patterns. 2) each friendly unit as a wireframe (default) and toggleable full detail with animation diorama, each with a small lore-friendly explanation as to what it does, 3) each sentry with wireframe, toggleable full detailed version with shooting animations against pearl-core enemies. All this as if was accessed from a Terminal as a screen-within-a-screen, with HUD elements and a border and CRT like display effects.' The brainstorm's decisions: 2026-10-14-bestiary-terminal-brainstorm; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-bestiary-terminal-design.md sections 1-7, this entry the enemies' piece (the friendly units and the sentries are later pages of the same terminal). Branch bestiary, cut from pearl-enemies at 70ab8f86; not merged.
outcome:
How to open it: the game, index.html?creatures=pearl#td (or any story run; e.g. index.html?skip=defence&sector=2&creatures=pearl#td), B once the hull is the player's (no seat, shot or modal), or drive the hull under the Stålheart's gantry and read the prompt TERMINAL · B; the lab, labs.html#units, the BESTIARY button in the header row (or B). Keys inside: up/down or W/S entries, Enter or Space the pack 3/6, Escape or B closes.

What landed (six commits): (1) 970c60c9 src/fx/crt-pass.js, the ground feed's CRT shader moved out unchanged (createCrtPass({ mono, tint, floor, gain }), render(renderer, source, rect), step(dt, static)); SAT-3's feed draws through its mono pass, the fragment to the character (test/crt-pass.mjs holds the 2026-10-13 text and numbers); a colour mode runs the same steps per channel. (2) 8bb204d4 src/domain/bestiary.js (pure: the roster, entryState full / silhouette / unseen and the lab's all-full, the card, the lure's lemniscate and its step, the pack's seats, the sightings record) and src/content/bestiary.js (the terminal's copy, section 6's text verbatim as ENTRIES for the owner to edit, the stage's numbers, the colour CRT, the store key); test/bestiary.mjs. (3) c003ec09 src/fx/bestiary-stage.js: a scene of its own on the story planet's bend (R 753 m), a bent disc with rings and the lure's track, the lure, and the entry's pack of its smallest type through the game's createPearlFamily with the game's tables at the high hull forced and the cap lifted (the swarm lab's lod.force and geometries(), ported as the identical hunks of branch swarm-lab-pearl so a merge sees one change), each body's record walking at the lure at its paced walk; the Cutis-Maku through createCutisFamily (now taking a level object); the camera orbits the pack's middle a third of the way to the lure. (4) 39dc838b src/fx/terminal-screen.js on the page's body (the frame, corner marks, the header's HUD lines, the list, the card, the footer, scanlines; the stage's box the one hole, its box-shadow painting the window black; the stage into a render target at the device pixel ratio, through the colour CRT into the host's canvas); src/fx/story-base.js inside() (the model's box from above in its holder's frame: the Stålheart is not solid, so solidAt never sees it); src/fx/contact-card.js onContact (a kind's first rise is its sighting); td-tab four lines (6,120 -> 6,124 of 6,400; 0 long lines): the factory literal, the paused branch's frame, the console's tick, the harness's bestiary { open, close, state, note(type), select, pack }. (5) fb0e1979 labs.html#units: the BESTIARY button, every entry full, the bench held still under it. (6) cc6268fb scripts/browser-test.mjs --bestiary.

Decided in the executing (the spec could not work as written, or left it open): THE KEY B is bound nowhere (searched every keydown handler for 'KeyB', key === 'b', 'B': none in src, scripts or the pages). THE LADDER: the set ranks orange (3) before blue (4), the spec's card example reads ENTRY 04 / 11 · ORANGE TIER, so the tiers go up the game's belt ladder, soft then cored, each by the set's rank: white, yellow, blue, orange, green, purple, brown, black. THE LURE cannot be both a closed loop and never caught: a body walking straight at it cuts across, and on a lemniscate it was cornered at the tips (offline: leaps of 8-12 m a frame when pushed along the loop, even against chasers at 0.6x its mean speed); it is prey now: it turns back along the loop when on would close on the nearest body, runs up to 3.5x faster as a body closes, and is never left within 6 m of any body of the pack (it slides off the loop to that distance, round the stage's bound if pinned there, then eases back on): at most 0.19 m a frame, 6.00 m closest over two minutes for every tier's pack of 3 and 6 and a 3.5 m/s pack of six in node. THE STORE is td.bestiary, not bestiary: the storage wrapper's exportRecords and importRecords only carry td. and ssg. keys. THE SILHOUETTE is a define the stage patches into its own family's membrane materials before the kit's tone mapping (flat near-black, alpha doubled), the pearls hidden: an override material cannot draw the kit's bodies, their shape is its vertex shader. THE KIT CREATURES: the Cutis-Maku stages (its family seats on a plane as the Pearl family does; the small tier); the Reeds and the Nih-Dairia are cards with stage: false (the Reed family simulates on a frame of its own on the unit sphere, src/fx/creature-reed.js, and does not seat on the stage's bent disc within this piece; the Nih-Dairia's stage is out of the piece); the Nih-Dairia's type is its own ('nih-dairia', the Reed family's huge tier's numbers), never logged by the game yet, so it stays unseen until a later piece logs it. ISAO'S CONSOLE LINE goes through isaoSpeak('console_first', { text }) and, unrecorded, shows as the prompt's second line for nine seconds. THE HARNESS needed the gantry's cell: the host's spot() (the heart's cell, the base's centre under the Stålheart). THE PROMPT: after a reload the hull already stands under the gantry (the bays are behind the Stålheart), so the prompt and Isao's line come at once on such a run.
alternatives: A lure that only runs on along its loop and is pushed on when caught (the spec's lurePoint(t, nearest)): cornered at the lemniscate's tips by any body cutting across, then leaping 8-12 m along the loop in a frame; replaced by the prey rule above.

The silhouette as an override material on the group: the kit's bodies are instanced and deformed in their vertex shader, so a stock material draws nothing in their shape; the define in the stage's own materials keeps the shape and leaves the game's family (a different instance) untouched.

Staging the Reeds through createReedFamily: its bodies live on the unit sphere through per-body surface frames and cancel the bodies' root, not on a bent plane; left as a card (stage: false) as the spec allows.
The storage key `bestiary` as the spec names it: outside the wrapper's td./ssg. allow-list, exportRecords would drop it.
